name: SM_Duck_Statue_Gold_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: the golden duck statue: a gilt duck, 0.9 m, standing on a dark blue-grey rock mound, 2.1 m in all
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The duck is a fused blob form with a wing relief and feather ridges from displacement: no modelled primaries, webbing or eye, so at 1 m it reads as a cast lump in the shape of a duck. Gilding is clean gold with dirt in the hollows and a few worn patches. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; carving detail comes from displacement, not from modelled tool work.
